title: Fenerbahce beat Anadolu Efes to clinch BSL title
description: Anadolu Efes - Fenerbahce 80-92 Fenerbahce clinched BSL title. They defeated Anadolu Efes on the road tonight to earn the decisive third win in the championship series. The victory marked the 10th Turkish League triumph for Fenerbahce. The game was mostly controlled by Fenerbahce. Efes managed to win second period 23-17. But it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. They outrebounded Efes 31-20 including 23 on the defensive glass. Fenerbahce looked well-organized offensively handing out 28 assists. Worth to mention a great performance of Czech center Jan Vesely (213-1990, agency: BeoBasket) who helped to win the game recording 18 points and 7 rebounds (on 9-of-10 shooting from the field).
